review_scope: The two authorized Round-2 wording obligations only; no new standards are introduced.

items.inherited_criterion: The appendix project summary explicitly pairs -0.00831 with +0.00583 and identifies -0.00914 as separate recent-price-control robustness.
items.fully_addressed: The appendix project summary identifies -0.00831 as the development baseline matched to the frozen +0.00583 estimate and identifies -0.00914 only as a separate development recent-price-control robustness estimate.
items.partially_addressed: The three estimates are present, but their matched-baseline and separate-robustness roles remain unclear or another relevant appendix comparison still conflates them.
items.made_worse_discriminator: The revision newly pairs +0.00583 with -0.00914 as matched baseline estimates, mislabels -0.00831, or otherwise increases estimand conflation.

items.inherited_criterion: The results synthesis and appendix project summary limit the instability finding to the measured baseline pipeline association and explicitly state that its cause is unidentified.
items.fully_addressed: Both the results synthesis and appendix project summary describe instability only in the measured baseline pipeline association and explicitly state that the evidence does not identify its cause.
items.partially_addressed: One of the two expected passages is bounded correctly, but the other remains broader than the measured baseline pipeline association or does not leave the cause unidentified.
items.made_worse_discriminator: The revision strengthens causal attribution, presents a plausible explanation as established, or broadens the instability claim beyond the measured baseline pipeline association.
items.expected_change_surface: Results synthesis (B0014) and appendix project summary Outcome (B0018).
